titleLine: Player Development Coach, LCB Training LLC
aboutParagraphs: I played the game known for my effort and love for the game, not just my stats. I coach with the same standard. Every player I work with gets asked one question: "What do you want to be known for?" Everything we do, from swing mechanics to mindset, connects back to that answer.

I have 12+ years of player development experience and currently coach high school varsity baseball. My goal is to build players who believe in themselves, love the game, and give an effort people notice.
aboutSummary: Known for effort, not just stats. I ask every player: What do you want to be known for? 12+ years in player development; current high school varsity coach building belief, love for the game, and noticeable effort.
accolades: NJCAA National Champion, Oakton Community College
experience: 12+ years as a Player Development Coach
Current High School Varsity Baseball Coach
philosophy: In-person training is one or two days a week. What happens on the other days is what shapes your development. I build the plan for those days so training carries over at home.

offerings.title: Team Training and Clinics
offerings.summary: In-person team and group sessions: hitting, fielding, speed, strength.
offerings.description: In-person sessions for teams and groups: hitting, fielding, speed and agility, and strength and mobility.

offerings.title: Testing Days
offerings.summary: Combine-style stations for baselines and tracking progress.
offerings.description: Combine-style testing stations so players and coaches have a baseline and can track progress.

offerings.title: Club Development Partnerships
offerings.summary: Club app access: drills, workouts, Playbook, team focus, and video feedback.
offerings.description: Club-wide access to the LCB Training app: a drill library, age-based workouts (gym, home weights, or bodyweight), The Playbook mindset guide, a weekly team focus, and video feedback from me. Teams train with you during the week, and the app covers the other days.

offerings.summary: Personal daily plan, weekly video breakdowns, and direct messaging.
offerings.description: My one-on-one program for players who want a personal daily plan, weekly video breakdowns, and direct messaging with me.
